workbook_notes: School Accountability Report Download File Notes
1. See the "Field Description" sheet for a description of the fields in the "Data" sheet.

2. Each row in the "Data" sheet represents a school and Report Card type. Choice schools that opted in to all-students reporting for 2024-25 will have two rows: one for the Private - Choice Students Report Card, the other for the Private - All Students Report Card.

3. For Private - Choice Student Report Cards, school enrollment only includes Choice students. For Private - All Students Report Cards, enrollment includes Choice students and private-paying students.
4. Data for subgroups of less than 20 students is not reported because statistics for groups below 20 are overly volatile. Masking in this way also protects student privacy.

5. Data for school and district report cards are from multiple sources: WSAS (Wisconsin Student Assessment System) results over a number of years (see directly below), school value-added growth data calculated from those WSAS results, enrollment, demographic, graduation, and attendance submitted by public school districts or private Choice schools through WISEdata.
6. WSAS data include results for the following assessments: Forward Exam, 9th and 10th grade PreACT Secure, 11th grade ACT, and Dynamic Learning Maps.

7. For districts comprised of only one school, the school report card serves for both school and district accountability purposes. The results for these schools are included in both this school download file and the district download file.
